verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Stripe Issuing is integrated alongside Treasury (fraud controls cover 'Treasury and Issuing', and embedded UI can render 'bill pay, issuing, and cash rewards'), implying cards can be tied to Treasury financial accounts, but no documentation details virtual/physical card issuance flow, spend controls, or digital wallet support specifically for Treasury accounts. Missing for 10: explicit docs on issuing virtual/physical cards via API tied to a Treasury account, spend-control configuration, and digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning details.
